title: Annual Mangrove Loss Slowed To 102,000 Hectares
hook: Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102,000 hectares.
closing: The slowdown matters, but every surviving mangrove still protects a coastline.
question: Can mangrove loss fall faster than coastlines are developed?

segments.say: Global mangrove area fell to 15.2 million hectares, leaving coastlines with less natural storm protection.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, more than any region in the comparison.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102,000 hectares, proving destruction can slow even before it stops.
